description: Source code for the display driver for the Sitronix ST7789V display controller in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, and data transmission functions.

methods.name: st7789v_set_lcd_margins
methods.description: Sets the LCD margins by updating x and y offsets in device data.

methods.name: st7789v_transmit
methods.description: Handles SPI transmission of commands and data to the display, managing command/data GPIO pin.

methods.name: st7789v_exit_sleep
methods.description: Sends command to exit sleep mode and waits for 120ms.

methods.name: st7789v_reset_display
methods.description: Resets the display via GPIO or software reset command.

methods.name: st7789v_set_mem_area
methods.description: Sets the memory area (window) for subsequent pixel data writes.

methods.name: st7789v_write
methods.description: Writes pixel data to specified area of the display buffer.

methods.name: st7789v_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and pixel format.

methods.name: st7789v_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the pixel format; only supports RGB565 or RGB888.

methods.name: st7789v_set_orientation
methods.description: Sets display orientation; only normal supported.

methods.name: st7789v_lcd_init
methods.description: Initializes the LCD with configuration commands.

methods.name: st7789v_init
methods.description: Performs hardware initialization, including SPI and GPIO setup, and resets the display.
